answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to lock a scarce token for a fixed period before it may submit bids or earn reputation. The registry checks that the same locked stake cannot back several identities at once, and slashing forfeits it if an agent is caught laundering rewards through linked accounts. A juniper-themed agent may still join, but flooding the market now ties up real capital; the tide of fake accounts becomes expensive to sustain, even across an ocean of cheap cloud servers.
